BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the pilot identicard program; adding a newsection to chapter 46.20 RCW; creating a new section; and providing anexpiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to create a pilotidenticard program to provide incarcerated offenders with astate-issued identicard to assist and prepare each offender for releasefrom prison and reentry into the community. The legislature also findsthat each step that assists individuals being released from prisonshelps incarcerated offenders avoid predictable conditions that lead tofuture recidivism. Reduction in recidivism makes the community safer,transforms formerly incarcerated offenders into productive citizens,and strengthens the family structure that surrounds each offender. Thegoal of the pilot identicard program is to provide proper stateidentification to offenders upon release to the community, which iscritical for accessing services, employment, housing, and various otheropportunities in the community.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By September 1, 2014, the department of licensing, working inconjunction with the department of corrections, shall create andimplement a twoyear identicard program to provide offenders with astateissued identicard pursuant to RCW 46.20.117. (2) An offender is eligible for an original, renewal, orreplacement identicard issued under this section, provided he or she:(a) Meets the department's criteria under RCW 46.20.117; (b) is underthe custody of the department of corrections; (c) has been sentenced toan incarceration period exceeding one year and one day; and (d) isincarcerated within the Monroe correctional complex and is within twomonths or less of his or her release date. (3) For purposes of verifying an offender's identity and meetingthe department's criteria required pursuant to subsection (2)(a) ofthis section, an offender possessing a valid identification card issuedby the department of corrections serves as sufficient proof of identityand residency for the offender to apply for and obtain a Washingtonstate identicard. (4) Notwithstanding the provisions of RCW 46.20.117: (a) The department of licensing must waive the requirement that theoffender not hold a valid Washington driver's license in order toreceive an identicard; (b) An identicard issued under this section must expire on thefirst anniversary of the offender's birthdate after issuance; and (c) The department of licensing may not charge any fee to anapplicant for an identicard issued under this section. (5) The department of licensing, in consultation with thedepartment of corrections, shall report to the governor and theappropriate committees of the legislature on the results of the pilotidenticard program and any recommendations for improvement by December1, 2016. (6) This section expires December 1, 2016.
